rows.definition: The reap-or-keep verdict for a stale git .git/index.lock: a Reap flag plus a closed-vocabulary reason, decided purely from the commit-lane observer's evidence (lock presence, process-probe success, live-writer count, staleness past the grace window).
rows.distinction: It is the ACTUATOR's act-or-not verdict on reclaiming an orphaned .git/index.lock, NOT the commit-lane status Verdict (the observer's clear/busy/stale/blocked lane read) and NOT the witness Decision (a CONFIRMED/REFUTED/ABSTAIN evidence-grading verdict).
